brief:
Hind Rajab, a Palestinian activist, filed a criminal complaint in Vietnam against an Israeli soldier, the Ma'an news agency reported. The complaint represents an attempt to pursue legal accountability through international judicial channels outside the Middle East.

The filing reflects broader efforts by Palestinian civil society organizations to seek legal recourse against Israeli military personnel in foreign courts. Such complaints filed in third countries operate under universal jurisdiction principles that allow nations to prosecute certain crimes regardless of where they occurred or the nationality of those involved. The specifics of the allegations against the soldier and his identity have not been made public.
title: Palestinian activist files criminal complaint against Israeli soldier in Vietnam
